nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I've been in this queue so long my cheque's gone off.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Paying in, then work. I tried ringing them from the counter phone. Alice says the line's been dead since she opened up. Dead. In a bank.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I have two kids and one alarm clock, and this morning the clock won.
